metadata.summary: A large-scale dataset for benchmarking medical question answering, sourced from professional medical board exam questions (USMLE-style), containing 12,723 question-answer pairs with explanations, covering multiple medical specialties and requiring multi-step clinical reasoning; includes a test split of 1,273 questions.
metadata.purpose: To advance research on medical knowledge question answering systems.

modality.scope: Multiple medical specialties (e.g., internal medicine, pediatrics, surgery, obstetrics/gynecology, psychiatry)

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。
pending_verification: 以下 LLM 字段因不符合 schema 约束已自动丢弃并回退基线值，待人工核实：medical_fields[list-items]

known_limitations: Source limited to USMLE-style exams, reflecting U.S.-centric medical education and practice norms
Lacks real-world clinical context (e.g., patient history, imaging, labs)
No demographic or socioeconomic attributes reported for examinees or question authors
Potential bias toward high-resource, English-dominant medical training environments
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: USMLE-focused content may not represent global medical curricula, practice guidelines, or patient populations.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup demographic data available; no reporting on representation across gender, ethnicity, or geographic origin of question authors or examinees.

population.target_population: Candidates taking USMLE-style medical licensing examinations in the United States
population.missing_groups: Non-US examinees; non-English-speaking populations; individuals outside formal medical training pathways

annotation.labeling_provenance: Questions and answers sourced directly from USMLE-style board exam materials; explanations provided by domain experts or derived from official answer keys.
